rationale.complete: Round 1 done: pre-registered predictions, synthetic validation (finite-N branching and the full pipeline on real village timelines), 32 per-period verdicts, cross-period tests, a scorecard, and a frozen, dry-run confirmatory script (not run). No natural-experiment test or holdout run yet. Round 1b (2026-10-04): re-run on context-ledger visibility with an H57 read-vs-unread placebo, and two ground-truth natives (#35 lead designers, #26 elected leader). Round 2 (2026-10-05): R1 (gamma-mixed branching, exact FN-GW law, skeleton null), R4 (paraphrase ideas, two embeddings, threshold sensitivity, planted-paraphrase check) and R2 (NE42 and five more non-reserved room changes, skeleton references) done with dated pre-registration and three amendments before real data. R3 (paid labels) and the holdout remain.
rationale.faithfulness: The subcritical, exposure-driven branching description holds everywhere (32/32 subcritical; HR10 beats the validated field null in 27/32), so C, D, F, G, H and I are each 1. The literal claim (a power law whose exponent reads criticality, tied to activity loop gains) failed. There is no s^-3/2, tau_app is just R-hat, P4 gave rho = 0.06, tails are heavier than one branching law, and the pre-registered forecast was overconfident. E = 0. Round 1b: HR10 now passes 32/32 (regime I was mismeasured), but not-yet-read uses predict adoption at about half the strength of read ones, so part of the exposure lock is convergence; known leaders are not idea sources. Axes unchanged. Round 2: C, D, F and H rise to 2 (the mixture beats one-ratio branching and the beta-binomial on held-out days; the unfitted non-root/root ratio 1.52 matches the mixture and excludes every homogeneous reference; exact law and synthetic recovery; node-level overdispersion beaten). E rises to 1: the NE42 reversal is predicted in sign and size, but skeleton worlds without dilution predict it too.
rationale.usefulness: A computable rule: R-hat from two days of logs gives next-day reach probabilities for new ideas or claims, and the post-hoc version is roughly calibrated (70-84% at 90%). The practical negative results also help: activity gains don't proxy idea spread, and exposure ordering can't separate copying from independent invention in a shared room. The calibration evidence is post hoc and the rule is unconfirmed, hence between a diagnostic (2) and a validated monitor (3). Round 2 adds a tail-risk rule (mean R about 0.2 with CV^2 about 1) and a monitoring rule (watch second-generation adopters, who out-spread inventors 1.5:1); it also shows paraphrase similarity measures shared reaction, not copying.

one_line: Idea cascades are subcritical (R about 0.2) and heterogeneous: a gamma mixture of idea-level branching ratios (CV^2 about 1) fits the heavy tail, adopters out-spread inventors 1.5:1, and branching reversed with room size across the NE42 merge and split.
